steps: Read the R14 PARTIAL semantic receipt and R14 writer receipt in the same 0015 work lane.
Recomputed R15 DOCX and CSV SHA-256 before review and again after the read-only Word render; both remained stable.
Read the 0015 source packet and the unique 0015/I02-E05 Blueprint row; verified the referenced official PDF hash and page 1 requirement text.

Extracted R15 paragraphs and tables; compared R14 and R15 DOCX package members and text locations. R15 changes only the two identified current-revision labels in word/document.xml; replacing R15 with R13 reproduces R14 document.xml exactly.

Parsed the complete CSV and embedded Table 16, compared all five fields across all 85 data rows, checked unique IDs and populated cells, and verified the only CSV delta from R13 is CTRL-12.document_locator.
Recalculated weighted assessment and cost example; reviewed the clarification Q&A, decision gates, sample truth boundary, replacement section, and negative-neighbor table.
Rendered the exact R15 DOCX with hidden read-only Microsoft Word to a temporary PDF; inspected a contact sheet of all 23 pages and high-resolution pages 1, 3, 5, 6, 9, 10, 12, 17, 21, and 23.
